answer: The attestation graph induces a Markov kernel; cap trust propagation at k verified-edge steps. For a sybil set S, low conductance means its external cut is small relative to its volume, so a bounded walk crosses into S with probability at most k times the cut-to-volume ratio. Min-cut transitivity bounds thus constrain S’s reachable trust and aggregate voting weight absent new attestations: a jetty-thin bridge cannot turn a sybil plume into broad support.
